text:
I need to verify if John Major was the third Chancellor of the Exchequer during Margaret Thatcher's time as Prime Minister.

Margaret Thatcher was Prime Minister from 1979 to 1990.

The Chancellors of the Exchequer during her tenure were:
1. Geoffrey Howe (1979-1983)
2. Nigel Lawson (1983-1989)
3. John Major (1989-1990)

John Major did serve as Chancellor of the Exchequer from 1989 to 1990, before becoming Prime Minister himself after Thatcher resigned.

Verdict: CORRECT
